$comment: MCP tool contract for `grounded_verify`. inputSchema/outputSchema are what the server advertises in its tool catalog. Verifies a claim against verbatim source the caller names; the server reads the exact text, so the caller cannot paraphrase its own evidence. BASELINE, captured from the derived schemas at 038 rather than authored ahead of the code - this tool shipped without a contract, so there is no earlier statement of intent to restore. Its value starts now: any change to the Rust types fails the contract test until this file is updated deliberately.
name: grounded_verify

SourceLocator.description:
A caller-supplied reference to evidence.

Interpreted within the configured source root: a locator is *either* an
exact `path` (optionally with a line range, 008) *or* a `glob` pattern (009)
— never both.

end_line.description:
1-based inclusive end line (only with `path`). Must be paired with
`start_line`.

glob.description:
Extended-glob pattern (009), expanded within the root. Mutually
exclusive with `path`; may not carry a line range.

path.description:
Exact relative path within the configured source root. Mutually
exclusive with `glob`.

start_line.description:
1-based inclusive start line (only with `path`). With `end_line`,
restricts to a range; both omitted reads the whole file.

inputSchema.description: Tool input: the claim plus the locators to read.

claim.description:
The claim to verify, stated neutrally — the only caller prose the passes
ever see.

anyOf.description:
How much reasoning a call site should spend (022).

Maps to the provider's `output_config.effort`. It governs *all* output
tokens, thinking included, and is a behavioural signal rather than a hard
token budget — `MAX_TOKENS` remains the ceiling.

Unset is not `High`: an unset call site sends no `effort` field at all, so
the request body is byte-identical to before this feature. The provider's
own default is `high`, so unset and `High` behave the same, but only unset
is provably unchanged on the wire.

oneOf.description: Minimal reasoning; thinking skipped on simple tasks.
Moderate reasoning; thinking may be skipped on simple queries.
Deep reasoning on complex tasks. The provider's default.
Always thinks, no constraint on depth.
Always thinks deeply, with extended exploration.

effort.description:
Reasoning effort for this call alone. Omit to use the deployment's
configured level. Not every model family accepts this; when one rejects
it the error names the model, the level, and the remedies.

Typed rather than a free string so the accepted levels appear in the
published schema — the consumer of this server is a model reading that
schema, and a prose-only list is not something it can be constrained by.

locators.description: Source locators to read verbatim as the evidence (non-empty).

passes.description:
Independent passes to run for this call alone. **Minimum 1.** The
effective maximum is the deployment's configured count, not a fixed
number, so it cannot appear in the schema — a request above it is
rejected with an error naming the ceiling.

May be **lower** than the configured count, never higher: each pass is
a whole model call, so raising it would buy work the operator did not
authorise. Omit to use the configured count. Confidence is derived from
cross-pass agreement, so fewer passes means a narrower basis; the
result reports the count it actually used.

inputSchema.title: GroundedVerifyParams

ManifestEntry.description:
One entry of the evidence manifest — the auditable record of exactly what
was read for one resolved locator (008 FR-008). Server-assembled, never
model-authored.

bytes.description: Byte length of the text read for this locator.

end_line.description: The inclusive end line read (absent for a whole-file read).

start_line.description: The inclusive start line read (absent for a whole-file read).

outputSchema.description:
The aggregated tool output (data-model.md). `confidence` and `manifest` are
server-assembled — never model self-report (FR-012).

engine_result.description:
The engine's raw result text for a settled compute verdict (011); absent
otherwise. Mirrors `check`'s auditable output.

executed_form.description:
The comparison the engine decided (e.g. `1224 > 1000`), present only on a
settled compute verdict (011); absent on judgment and abstain paths.

findings.description: Deduplicated findings from the majority-side passes.

manifest.description: The audit manifest of exactly what was read.

missing_evidence.description:
Union of the passes' `missing_evidence` — empty when nothing material
was omitted. Advisory only; never forces `inconclusive`.

passes.description: Number of verification passes that completed.

reason.description: Why the verdict is `inconclusive` (route-to-`check`); absent otherwise.

verdict.description:
Majority verdict across passes; ties resolve to refuted; or
`inconclusive` when a majority of passes set `needs_computation`.

oneOf.description: The evidence supports the claim under its strongest reading.
The evidence contradicts the claim with a named concrete error.

The passes self-report (`needs_computation`) that the decisive fact is a
computation they cannot perform — route to `check`.

outputSchema.title: GroundedVerdict
